close_reason: Fixed: added Hash to Error (all unit variants; derivable). Added doc comment to CertPool noting Hash is not derivable (Certificate doesn't impl Hash).
description: File: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs. Both types now derive Eq (from this review loop) but not Hash. Certificate (from x509-cert) does not impl Hash, so Hash is not derivable for CertPool. Add a comment explaining why Hash is absent, or add #[allow(clippy::derived_hash_with_manual_eq)] annotation. This affects testability in hash-based collections.
title: P3: CertPool and pkix-path-builder::Error derive Eq without Hash
